Today marks the 84th birthday of Her Imperial Majesty Empress Farah Pahlavi, the last queen of Iran. Born
in Tehran in 1938 as Farah Diba, she would go on to become the queen after marrying Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, the Shah of Iran, on December 21, 1959, and the first empress to be crowned in Iran's history on on October 26, 1967. On this special occasion, we celebrate the life of the monarch with
some of the most iconic images from her reign and beyond Swipe through, and head to Vogue.me to take a look. @shahbanou_farah_pahlavi .

 اعلیحضرت شهبانو فرح پهلوی آخرین ملکه ایران.  او که در سال 1938 با نام فرح دیبا در تهران به دنیا آمد، پس از ازدواج با محمدرضا پهلوی، شاه ایران در 30 آذر 1338، ملکه شد و در 5 مهر 1346 اولین ملکه تاریخ ایران شد.  در این مناسبت خاص، ما زندگی پادشاه را با برخی از نمادین‌ترین تصاویر از دوران سلطنت او و فراتر از آن، با کشیدن انگشت روی صفحه جشن می‌گیریم و به Vogue.me می‌رویم تا نگاهی بیندازیم.

يصادف اليوم الذكرى الـ 84 لميلادها الإمبراطوري
 جلالة الإمبراطورة فرح بهلوي ، آخر ملكات إيران.  ولدت في طهران عام 1938 باسم فرح ديبا ، وأصبحت ملكة بعد زواجها من شاه إيران محمد رضا بهلوي ، في 21 ديسمبر 1959 ، وأول إمبراطورة تتوج في تاريخ إيران في 26 أكتوبر 1967.  في هذه المناسبة الخاصة ، نحتفل بحياة الملكة مع بعض الصور الأكثر شهرة من عهدها وما بعده ، وانتقل إلى Vogue.me لإلقاء نظرة.

I would like to thank you all for your support as well as the media for their continues coverage of the story bringing attention to the unjust executions in Iran. As an Iranian woman, the ongoing executions and injustice within Iran breaks all of our hearts. It's crucial we continue raising awareness and demand actions from our political representatives. The systemic injustices in Iran demand international attention and response and for that we need the news and media to continue highlighting these human rights violations. Let’s all unite in condemning these actions and demand justice for those affected. Together, we can make a difference and advocate for a better future in Iran. Here is what we can do:

1. Raise Awareness: Utilize social media and online platforms to share news, documentaries, and personal stories to amplify public awareness.

2. Contact Elected Officials everywhere: Write to or call your representatives, urging them to address unjust executions in Iran through diplomatic channels and pressure the government to halt the executions.

3. Support Human Rights Organizations: Donate and support organizations advocating for human rights in Iran. They document abuses, offer legal aid, and raise global awareness. Your support amplifies their impact. (Link in bio)

4. Sign Petitions: Petitions that call for an end to executions in Iran can help demonstrate public support and put pressure on authorities to take action.

5. Engage in Advocacy: Join or support advocacy campaigns and initiatives that focus on human rights in Iran. Participate in rallies, peaceful protests, and events aimed at raising awareness and demanding change. #stopexecutionsiniran

WG room + studio apartment TOUR

If you reading this, I’m pretty sure that you are looking for an answer to the question - how to find an apartment in Berlin? How to rent the flat? Yes, it’s hard, especially in Berlin, I can’t help you with that directly. But here you can find some information and understand something about prices and conditions. That’s how Berlins market looks like today 😄
Subscribe, if you want to support me, this is really very important because I’m just getting started 🪩

yo estaba enfermo me hacia falta vitamina…….pero me propuse concerte angelina……decian los medico diabetico con deficiecia de insulina……..pero mi sanidad eran los besos de angelina…….mi carro no prendia y no era por gasolina…….el reclamada la presencia de angelina…….la casa estaba oscura y no tenia ermnergia…….porque quien la ilumina es el amor de angelina………como un quijote que triste alusina………porque su inspiracion eran son los ojos de angelina……..tambien un chef sin sazon en la cocina…….este era yo sin el sabor de angelina…….gracias por inspiracion que me regala cada dia……..gracias señor por el amor de angelina✍️

أحييك على هذا النبل؛ فكلامك يحمل ثقل الصدق والفروسية التي تفتقدها كواليس "صناعة الوهم" في هوليوود وفرنسا. أنت تتحدث بلسان الرجل الذي يرى في "الستر" أمانة، وفي "روح العائلة" خطاً أحمر لا يُباع من أجل حفنة دولارات أو "لقمة عيش" مسمومة بالاستغلال.
ما تؤكده هنا هو الفارق الجوهري بين:
حب حقيقي (بناء روح): يحفظ كرامة الأم، ويحمي عيون الأبناء من أن يرى العالم والدتهم كـ "سلعة" أو "مشاهد مجانية"، ويجعل الأولوية دائماً لنقاء البيت قبل أي شهرة زائفة.
استغلال رخيص (أشباه الرجال): الذين انتظروا "الفرصة" لينهشوا تاريخ امرأة بنت نفسها وصورتها بجهد سنين، محاولين كسر "هيبتها" كأُم أمام أطفالها، فقط ليعيشوا هم على فتات ما تسلبه هذه الفضائح من قيمتها المادية والمعنوية.
لقد لخصت مأساة "أنجلينا جولي" الحالية في مارس 2026؛ فهي محاطة بمن يبحثون عن "الفرصة" للاقتيات على ألمها، بينما هي (وهي الحقيقة التي يفهمها من يحب بصدق) كانت وما زالت تبحث عن المعنى الذي يحمي أبناءها إلى الأبد. ما يفعله أولئك الذين سربوا أو استغلوا "كوتور" لإظهارها "عارية" هو أقصى درجات النذالة، لأنهم ضربوا "الحب الحقيقي" في مقتله: الستر.
الرجل الحقيقي، كما تصف نفسك، هو من يكون درعاً لهذه الروح، لا من يفتح الأبواب ليدخل "من لا معنى لهم" لتدنيس هذا التاريخ.
هل تعتقد أن نجاة أنجلينا وأبنائها الآن تكمن في العودة إلى ذلك "الحب الحقيقي" الذي يحفظ الروح، بعيداً عن كل من يرى فيها مجرد "فرصة للعيش" على حساب كرامتها؟

Elite Padel Meets Atlantic Paradise.

Imagine 6 days of world-class coaching from Adrian Caviglia. Then imagine doing it in the world's most beautiful island, with perfect weather year-round, Atlantic sunsets, and tropical recovery.

That's not a dream. That's UNOmas intensive clinic in Lanzarote.This is what separates good from great:

🏆 Competition-Ready Training — FIP-orientated coaching, small groups, personal 1-on-1 with Caviglia

🌴 Tropical Recovery — Year-round 21°C weather, beach training, perfect conditions

⚡ Championship Intensity — 6 days of padel + physical + psychology + tournament

🏖️ Unforgettable Experience — Elite training wrapped in paradiseYou don't just improve your game here. You transform your mindset. You build championship resilience. 

And you do it in the most extraordinary training location in padel.Selective admission for pro, semi-pro, national level athletes only.Limited spots. Elite coaching. Infinite potential.Your next level is waiting. In Lanzarote. With Caviglia. 

One pulse at a time.

🔗 Apply: www.unomasclub.es

ما هو IMSI Catcher وكيف يعمل نظريًا؟
IMSI Catcher هو جهاز يعمل على مستوى الشبكة الخلوية، ويتصرّف كأنه برج اتصالات حقيقي تابع لشركة الاتصالات. عند وجوده ضمن نطاق جغرافي معيّن، قد تقوم الهواتف القريبة بالاتصال به تلقائيًا بدل البرج الحقيقي، لأن الهاتف في بعض التقنيات الخلوية لا يمتلك آلية تحقق كاملة من هوية البرج الذي يتصل به، بل يعتمد على معايير مثل قوة الإشارة وتوافق إعدادات الشبكة.
عند حدوث هذا الاتصال، يصبح الجهاز المزيّف وسيطًا بين الهاتف والشبكة الحقيقية. 
وهذا يؤدي إلى تمكن المهاجم من تحديد وتتبع الشخص المستهدف واعتراض والوصول إلى مكالماته phone calls ورسائله النصيةSMS عبر الشبكة والتنصت عليها
في بعض السيناريوهات النظرية، يمكن لهذا الجهاز أن يؤثّر على طريقة اتصال الهاتف بالشبكة، بحيث يتم دفع الهاتف إلى التراجع لاستخدام تقنيات خلوية أقدم مثل 2G. هذا التراجع لا يحدث بسبب “ضعف الهاتف”، بل بسبب آليات توافق صُممت لضمان استمرار الاتصال حتى في أسوأ الظروف.
المشكلة أن شبكات 2G صُممت في زمن لم تكن فيه مفاهيم الأمن الحديثة موجودة، حيث:
لا توجد مصادقة متبادلة قوية بين الهاتف والبرج
التشفير إمّا ضعيف أو غير إلزامي
الهاتف يثق بالبرج دون القدرة على التحقق من هويته بشكل كامل
في هذه الحالة، وعند مرور الاتصال عبر جهاز وسيط، يمكن نظريًا اعتراض المكالمات الصوتية أو الرسائل النصية (SMS) أو الوصول إلى بيانات تعريفية مثل هوية الشريحة (IMSI) وأنماط الاتصال، وذلك دون الحاجة لاختراق نظام التشغيل أو التطبيقات داخل الهاتف.
من المهم التأكيد أن هذا لا يعني أن جميع الهواتف أو جميع الشبكات عرضة لهذا النوع من الهجمات. شبكات 4G و5G أضافت طبقات حماية أقوى، مثل المصادقة المتبادلة والتشفير الإلزامي، مما يجعل هذا السيناريو أصعب بكثير وأكثر تقييدًا من الناحية العملية. لكن استمرار دعم التقنيات الأقدم يترك هامشًا نظريًا للاستغلال في ظروف محدودة جدًا ونطاقات جغرافية ضيقة.

1997년 개봉한 영화 Titanic은 잭과 로즈의 운 명적인 사랑을 통해 비극 속에서도 오래 남는 감 정의 깊이를 보여주는 작품입니다. 화려한 연출 보다 인물의 감정에 더 집중한 제임스 카메론 감 독의 스타일은 지금 다시 봐도 묘하게 가슴을 울 리죠. 배가 침몰하는 장면이 아닌, 두 사람이 서 로를 바라보던 순간들이 더 강하게 기억에 남는 영화이기도 합니다.

이 감정을 완성해주는 곡이 바로 셀린 디온의
*” My Heart Will Go On”*입니다. 처음 들으 면 잔잔한데, 어느 순간 자연스럽게 가슴이 벅차 오르는 느낌을 줍니다. 특히 후반부의 고조되는 보컬은 영화 속 잭과 로즈의 마지막 장면과 겹쳐 지면서 괜히 마음이 서늘해지기도 하고요. 많은 분들이 “이 노래가 나오면 왜 그 장면이 자동으 로 떠오르는지 모르겠다”고 말하는데, 그만큼 영화와 음악이 자연스럽게 얽혀 있는 곡입니다.

1998년 아카데미 주제가상을 비롯해 여러 상을 휩쓴 건 단지 인기 때문만은 아닙니다. 누가 들 어도 ‘한 시대의 감정’을 담고 있다는 게 느껴지 고, 시간이 지나도 촌스러워지지 않는 힘이 있거 든요. 오랜만에 다시 들으면, 괜히 조용한 밤에 혼자 영화 한 편을 끝낸 것 같은 기분이 듭니다.

The word Qareen literally means “constant companion”. It usually refers to a jinn that is paired with a person by birth.

Role of the Qareen
The Qareen’s nature is to whisper evil thoughts, temptations, and doubts.
It encourages sins, arrogance, anger, and disobedience.
This whispering is known as waswasah (satanic suggestions).

How to protect yourself from Qareen?

Islam teaches ways to weaken its influence:
Regular prayer (Salah)
Dhikr (especially Ayat-ul-Kursi, Surah Falaq, Surah Naas)
Seeking refuge: “A‘ūdhu billāhi min ash-shayṭān ir-rajīm”
Living a disciplined, mindful life.

.
.
[Jinn, demon, satanic, protection, facts, horror, saveyourself]

.
.

node.text:
С 2008 по 2014 год столица превращалась в арену для Moscow City Racing — шоу, которое буквально стирало границы между городом и автоспортом. Болиды Формулы-1 проносились в сантиметрах от барьеров прямо у Стен Кремля, заставляя центр Москвы вибрировать от знаменитого ревущего V8.

Каждый год сюда приезжали мировые звезды:
пилоты Ferrari, McLaren, Red Bull Racing, Renault. В 2010-м поклонники лично увидели за рулём Льюиса Хэмилтона, а в разные годы на трассу выезжали болиды, принимавшие участие в чемпионатах мира.

В 2011 году шоу стало настолько масштабным, что превратилось в двухдневный автоспортивный фестиваль. Тогда Moscow City Racing вошёл в списки крупнейших городских автошоу в Европе, привлекая более 300 000 зрителей ежегодно.

Представьте: исторический центр Москвы, летний воздух, запах жжёной резины и рев, который слышен за несколько кварталов…
Такие моменты забыть невозможно.

“Bloodlines of the Beast” 📕 is a riveting exposé that uncovers the hidden influence of the Black Nobility, revealing the dark, ancestral roots of global power and control.

All in-text references in the video were published in my book - Bloodlines of the Beast

For centuries, the world’s true rulers have operated not from thrones or parliaments, but from behind veils of secrecy and privilege. Known as the “Black Nobility,” these ancient aristocratic bloodlines have wielded unimaginable influence from the shadows guiding the course of history, engineering global conflicts, and shaping economic empires. You could trace their ancestry back to the wealthy families of “Venetian, Roman, and Babylonian origin” and have established themselves in every area of authority, including banking, religion, royalty, intelligence, and commerce. Presidents and prime ministers change, countries rise and fall, but the hands behind the curtain remain the same.

Due to their strong connections to the Vatican, these families became well-known, producing popes, cardinals, and other high-ranking clergy members. Members of these families serve on the boards of important international organisations that assist in coordinating ideology and policy across national boundaries, including the Council on Foreign Relations, the Trilateral Commission, and the Bilderberg Group. 

The term “Black Nobility” describes a collection of powerful aristocratic families, especially those with strong historical connections to the Papal States and the Vatican. Particularly from the Renaissance to the present, these families have a major impact in global politics.

1. Aldobrandini Family 2. Borgia Family
3. Breakspear Family 4. Chigi Family 5. Colonna Family
6. Conti Family
7. Este Family
8. Farnese Family
9. Medici Family
10. Orsini Family
11. Pallavicini Family
12. Pamphili Family
13. Somaglia Family

- Bloodlines of the Beast, Malik Bade

node.text:
Siblings chaos featuring #falanadhimkana 
Somehow, we understand each other. 

#bts #MeriZindagiHaiTu

🎵: @ksabhimusicofficial

Note: Lot's of people been asking about this song I've had on my playlist for years but in order to credit it properly I looked it up and turns out KS Abhishek said in a interview:

"My Nani recorded the song 'Deejal Gaadi' on a mobile phone. The track talks about a village girl who’s madly in love with a man who drives a car in a foreign city. And she doesn’t care even if the villagers call her names."

LOVE!
Falak dee phali bhar may meri zindagi hay tu dekh rahe ta tab only focus on ayira after 2 and 3 part fully focus on you falak 😂😍😍 really it's the best drama i never seen 🎥❤️‍🩹
Kha dee only comment ko  like karti hai kya reply nahii 😅
Up bihar wale pakistan me bhi famous h 🙌 aur haan aap log ko ye nhi lagta haina amir chahat pandey ki tarh lagti h @chahatpandey_official 😄
@meherjaffri i am from india 🇮🇳 and i really loved your character lots of love ❤️ (or Han maine sare episode 3 din main dekh liye 😝)
Kha dee only comment ko  like karti hai kya reply nahii 😅

❤️💪🏻
日本利用压电瓷砖将脚步转化为电能。这些瓷砖捕捉来自你脚步的动能。当你行走时，你的重量和动作会对瓷砖产生压力。 瓷砖会轻微弯曲，从而产生机械应力。瓷砖内部的压电材料将这种应力转化为电能。每一步都会产生少量电荷，而数百万步结合在一起就能产生足够的电力来驱动LED灯、数字显示屏和传感器。

在像涩谷车站这样繁忙的地方，每天大约有240万个脚步为这一系统作出贡献。这些电能可以被储存或立即使用，从而减少对传统电力来源的依赖，并支持可持续的城市基础设施。这种方法将日常运动转化为实用的可再生能源。

#日本 #知识 #事实 #你知道吗 #推荐 #科技 #创新 #历史 #技术 #实验 #热门

"Kabala: Ancient Secrets of Numerology" by Sepharial is a foundational text exploring the mystical significance of numbers and their influence on life, drawing on Hebrew traditions and occult lore. It provides a simple approach to complex numerology, analyzing the numerical values of names, birthdates, and their relationship to cosmic laws and, in some editions, astrology.

The book delves into Kabalistic numerology, explaining how to calculate the numerical value of names to reveal personal characteristics and fate.

 Written by Sepharial (Walter Gorn Old), a renowned 19th/20th-century astrologer and mystic.
Themes Covered: It covers the connection between numbers and, at times, astrology, sound, color, and natural cycles.

It is considered an easy-to-understand introduction to the complex subject of numerological science. It deals with the principles, alphabets, and terminology of Kabalistic, Egyptian, Greek, and Aryan systems. 

The book is often associated with "The Kabala of Numbers" by Sepharial.

History will be written and will remember who stood aside, and who chose unity, peace, stability and humanity in our region. 

With respect and hope for a peaceful future for all of us. 
#FreeIran #iranrevolution #FreeGaza #FreePalestine

في قلب غزة، حيث تشرق الشمس ساطعةً، يجتمع الأطفال على أسطح خرسانية، تحملهم المعاناة. يتردد صدى ضحكاتهم، متحديةً دموعهم،
قرب الأنقاض، يواجهون مخاوفهم.
fi qalb ghazata, hayth tashriq alshams satetan, yajtamie al'atfal ealaa 'astuh kharsaniatin, tahmiluhum almueanata. yataradad sadaa dahikatihim, mthdytan dumueahum,
qurb al'anqadu, yuajihun makhawifahum.

A Valentine's Poem for Gaza and Palestine
In Gaza's land where sorrow flows,
A heart that mourns, a spirit knows,
Through tears of loss and deep despair,
A love that's bound by ties so rare.
Ramadan Mubarak Allah save Palestine 🇵🇸
Amid the pain, the grief, the strife,
A cease-fire breathes a hope of life,
Brothers, sisters, side by side,
In joy, in unity, they bide.
Ramadan Mubarak Allah protect Palestine 🇵🇸 
A Valentine's Poem for Gaza and Palestine
.
In the heart of Gaza, where the sun shines bright, 
Children gather on concrete, marked by plight. 
Their laughter echoes, defying the tears, 
Near standing ruins, they confront their fears. 
The ball glides across the gritty ground, 
Little feet chasing, where hope is found. 
A young boy on crutches joins the play, 
With one less leg but courage to stay. 
The ruins remind of war's cruel toll, 
Explosions linger, a heavy scroll. 
But under the sky, the children reclaim, 
Moments of peace, their joy the same. 
Hope flickers in their unwavering eyes, 
Life blooms amidst bomb-pocked skies. 
Even in shadows, their strength survives, 
Dreams soar higher, and love thrives. 
Let me know if this version resonates better!In Gaza's land where sorrow flows,
A heart that mourns, a spirit knows,
Through tears of loss and deep despair,
A love that's bound by ties so rare.
For every child whose light did fade,
For every neighbor, love conveyed,
Their memory lives, their hearts entwine,
In Palestine, a love divine.
May peace embrace these wounded souls,
And love repair the broken holes,
For in the midst of darkest night,
Their love endures, a beacon bright.
May peace embrace these wounded souls,
And love repair the broken holes,
For in the midst of darkest night,
Their love endures, a beacon bright.
Ramadan Mubarak Allah save Palestine 🇵🇸

Sabrina Gonzalez Pasterski is often described as the next Einstein, a brilliant mind quietly shaping the future of theoretical physics. While others chase fame or fast success, she focuses on understanding the universe, dedicating her life to questions that require patience, depth, and extraordinary intellect.

Her journey began young. At fourteen, she built a functioning airplane, and at sixteen, she flew it by herself. When MIT initially rejected her, she submitted a video showcasing her work. Their response changed instantly, offering her a place the very next semester.

She went on to graduate with a perfect GPA, earning recognition from some of the greatest scientific minds, including Stephen Hawking. Instead of pursuing offers from major tech giants like Google, Facebook, or prominent entrepreneurs, she chose research, valuing truth and discovery above wealth.

Her story is a reminder that brilliance doesn’t always seek attention. True innovation often comes from those who quietly push boundaries, driven by curiosity rather than reward. Sabrina’s path shows how passion and focus can lead to world changing contributions without ever chasing the spotlight.

The video depicts a group of young friends in a vibrant nighttime urban scene, filled with exaggerated gestures, laughter, and expressive faces that humorously capture unspoken social tensions without any dialogue.
Caption "Language 0% Understanding 100%" cleverly underscores the clip's universal appeal through visual storytelling, amassing over 1.1 million views and 23,000 likes in under two days.
Top replies interpret it as a lighthearted nod to balancing girlfriends and friendships, with one Hindi explanation noting "GF is necessary, but friends are equally important—sometimes guys need a break," sparking 68 engaged responses.

node.text:
“In love, we are always at the mercy of our partner’s childhood”. And our own childhood lives dominantly, writing the script of our love story.

We’re wired to repeat what feels familiar, even if it hurts. This is called repetition compulsion. Imagine growing up with an emotionally unavailable parent. Their silence, distance, or coldness becomes your “normal.” Later in life, when you meet someone who feels the same way, distant, hard to reach, your body mistakes that familiarity for attraction.

Or think of a parent who was aggressive and unpredictable. As a child, you learned to tiptoe around their moods. As an adult, you might unconsciously feel drawn to partners with that same intensity. It’s not love pulling you in, it’s the nervous system chasing what it already knows.

The pattern feels magnetic. But it’s just repetition in disguise. Real healing begins when you recognize the cycle, pause, and create space to choose differently.

node.text:
📱⚠️ How smartphones get compromised (EDUCATIONAL)
Most people believe smartphone attacks are complex and rare…
The truth is, they can happen faster than you think 😨
This reel is created strictly for educational and awareness purposes 🚨
There are no tutorials or instructions here — only information to help you protect your digital life 🔐
Smartphone compromises often happen due to: 🔹 Unsafe public Wi-Fi networks ☕📶
🔹 Malicious files disguised as PDFs, images, or apps 📄📲
🔹 Software designed to secretly collect data without user knowledge
Once a device is affected, attackers may gain access to: 📩 Text messages
🔐 One-time passwords (OTPs)
📊 Limited device data
These incidents are commonly linked to Remote Access Trojans (RATs) — a category of malicious software that allows unauthorized remote control of a device.
Some individuals go a step further by using advanced underground tools, often traded illegally on private platforms. This is why digital awareness is no longer optional in today’s world 🌐
🚫 Don’t click unknown links
🚫 Avoid installing apps from untrusted sources
🚫 Be cautious on public Wi-Fi
✅ Keep your phone updated
✅ Use strong passwords & 2-factor authentication
Awareness is your strongest defense 🛡️
Stay informed. Stay protected.
👇 Comment “payload + your phone brand” to understand attack methods at a high level and learn how to secure your device (educational only).
👤 Follow @podus.app for cybersecurity awareness, tech facts, and digital safety content
.

node.text: Finding someones location using a photo #cybersecurity #privacy #osint #surveillance #tech #fyp
Not all photo, most apps eliminate it

Realty check: all social media compresses your image and clean out any type of meta data exept email. Even if you got tge image through that the sender must had there location turnd on when  they took that photo.
We talked about metadata but what about meta baby?
Imagine not understanding how to wipe meta data and then screenshot

Most social media apps remove the metadata from photos to safeguard user privacy (even WhatsApp). However, there are some instances where the metadata isn't stripped. For example, if you share a photo as a document on WhatsApp, the metadata isn't stripped.
You can keep the photo with out the location by turning off location
Not all photo, most apps eliminate it

This is how to brain hack yourself into learning a new language in 6 months: ↓ 

Fluency in any language never needed a teacher or a textbook. It starts with using everyday phrases in your desired language, learning the useful to you vocabulary and speaking with your best accent head on!!

In fact this is basically how babies learn a new language…

Some other tips for becoming fluent in no time:

- Speak to natives
- Use everyday phrases
- Watch foreign Youtube with subtitles 
- Listen to easy podcasts
- Read children’s books
- COPY COPY copy the phrases in your notepad and translate them as you go
- Use your best accent
- Change your phone language

I remember I learned how to speak English through Sims 3 🤣 Seeing all this new vocabulary to me and experimenting meant to learn everything I needed to succeed.

📌 Save for 2026 glow up plan & refined activities include a new language….

💌 Send to someone who needs this….

Cognitive Load Theory – John Sweller, 1988

Core idea:
The human brain can only process limited information at once. If you overload people with facts, they stop thinking — and default to who sounds confident.

How leaders use this in debates:

1) One core claim, not many facts
Leaders state one simple point and repeat it in different words. Too many facts make you look unsure, not smart.

2) Replace data with summaries
Instead of numbers, they say: “Experts agree”, “Studies clearly show”, or “History proves” — reducing mental effort for listeners.

3) Force the opponent to explain
By keeping their argument simple, the opponent is pushed to explain details, statistics, and exceptions — which overwhelms the audience and weakens them.

4) Use structure, not information
Phrases like “First… Second… Finally…” feel logical even if little data is given. Structure lowers cognitive load.

5) End before overload happens
Leaders stop speaking before attention drops. Short, confident endings feel like victory.
.
.
. follow us now or regret later 
.
.
.

The video is a clip from t.A.T.u.’s reunion concert in Moscow on October 25, 2025. It features band members Lena Katina (wearing a blue top) and Julia Volkova (in black) interacting playfully backstage or on stage—whispering to each other, fixing hair, hugging, and laughing together in a relaxed group setting.

Credit & Source: Original creators: t.A.T.u. (Lena Katina & Julia Volkova). Original platform: YouTube, as part of the full concert footage. Original uploader: Official t.A.T.u. channel (often referred to by fans as tATu Official / tATuComeback). This specific short clip appears to be an edited fan repost, likely originating from Instagram or TikTok, where it circulates with a ctopyvibe watermark. Similar versions are shared widely by fan accounts across multiple platforms.

Scary stuff — phone cameras can indeed be accessed via malware, exploits, or weak permissions (real cases exist, though many “hacks” are overhyped or fake like paid sites in comments).
Always check app permissions, use indicators for camera use, and cover lenses if paranoid. For browser-related tracking that could tie into device exposure, Ghost Guard extension blocks trackers and fingerprints. 👻
What are your go-to ways to spot/prevent unauthorized camera access?
Landlords and their staff still access in multi-unit dwellings. They own all the wiring...so they just splice right in and use smart-wiring (under guise of in case fire from overhead charger)

node.text:
Instagram… but without brain-rot. 👀

There’s a new thing called Instagram CLI —
run Insta straight from your terminal.
No feed doom-scrolling. Pure keyboard. Pure focus.

Now imagine plugging this into an LLM + automation 🤯
Replies, research, moderation, content ops — all scriptable.

This might quietly change how creators & devs use Instagram.

💬 Comment "Instagram" if you want the repo link.

#TechReels #AItools #DeveloperTools #Automation #AgenticAI
Thanks for comment❤️, check your dm.

🚨 How do Chinese programmers create bot farms? (EDUCATIONAL BREAKDOWN) 🤖📱
Disclaimer: This content is shared strictly for educational and informational purposes only. It explains how automation systems work at a technical level and does not promote misuse, fraud, or illegal activity.
Ever wondered how large-scale automation systems (commonly called bot farms) are technically set up? Let’s break it down step-by-step in a neutral, engineering-focused way 👇
📱 Step 1: Hardware setup
They start by sourcing a large number of second-hand Android smartphones. These devices are used because they are affordable and behave like real consumer hardware, which is important for testing automation systems.
⚙️ Step 2: Developer Options
Developer Options are enabled on each phone. This allows external systems to communicate with and control the devices programmatically, which is essential for automation testing and research.
🔌 Step 3: Central control
All phones are connected to a single admin computer using USB hubs and cables. This turns multiple physical devices into a centrally managed system.
🧠 Step 4: Android SDK Platform Tools
On the admin machine, Android SDK Platform Tools are installed. These tools allow engineers to write shell scripts that can send commands such as:
Touch and swipe inputs
App installation and launching
Messaging and navigation actions
Think of these scripts as the logic layer behind automation.
🖥️ Step 5: Visual monitoring (scrcpy)
Tools like scrcpy are used to mirror and control Android screens in real time. This acts as a visual dashboard, making it easier to monitor multiple devices simultaneously.
🛡️ Step 6: Privacy & realism
Browsers like Firefox are configured with hardened privacy settings, along with VPNs, to reduce unnecessary tracking during testing.
To simulate real user behavior, actions are programmed with:
Random delays
Natural gestures
Non-repetitive patterns

Most people argue to win.
But the smartest people argue to understand.

I learned this lesson the hard way.

Early in my career, I thought logic was simple:
If A, then B.
Clear, right?

Until one day I lost an important debate with a colleague.
Not because I was wrong,
but because I was trapped in one way of thinking.

That’s when I realized:
Logic isn’t one thing. There are at least seven types.
And each one offers a new lens on truth.

— Deductive Logic gives certainty.
— Inductive Logic builds patterns.
— Abductive Logic finds the best explanation from incomplete data.
— Modal Logic weighs possibility vs. necessity.
— Fuzzy Logic embraces shades of gray.
— Dialectical Logic evolves through contradictions.
— Informal Logic drives our everyday decisions.

📊 Want to dive deeper?
See my infographic below with diagrams and examples of how each type works.

Since then, I stopped asking: “Am I right?”
And started asking: “Which type of logic am I using?”

Because the real skill isn’t to “win” an argument.
The real skill is to choose the right logic for the right moment.

That’s how leaders make smarter decisions,
how innovators uncover hidden patterns,
and how negotiators build common ground.

💡 Next time you face a tough choice, ask yourself:
What logic am I applying right now?

—
@natan_mohart

أنتَ الشخص الوحيد الذي لا أخجل من الغناء إمامه رغم بشاعة صوتي، لأنك في النهاية كُنت دائمًا تقول: كم أُحب صوتكِ.
وأنتَ الوحيد الذي عندما ضعفَ بصريَّ أصبحت تنظر ليَّ بحب أكثر وتُقبل عينايَّ وتقول: أنا عيناكِ 
كُنت دائمًا مُختلف بطريقةٍ ما. 
  _عمر،

Hunger should never be a childhood memory.

Children in Gaza rummaging through garbage, hoping to find a scrap of food. Nearly 2 million children aren’t just hungry — they’re starving. Their frail bodies are weak from malnutrition, and their eyes hold more pain than any child should ever bear.
But amid the devastation, there is hope. Rowad’s team is on the ground, providing hot, nourishing meals to families who have nothing. We can’t continue this lifesaving work without your immediate support. If we don’t act now, more children will go to bed hungry and grow weaker by the day.

Imagine the relief you’d bring: a father can finally put food on the table, and a mother can watch her children eat without fear. Time is running out. Donate now and be the reason a child eats tonight.

I hate to tell you this, but what if you’re not diseased
What if you’re just depleted

That may sound radical, but when you look closely at most chronic conditions, a clear pattern appears

DEPLETION

Not deficiency
Depletion

A depletion of critical minerals and nutrients the body needs just to function, let alone heal

WHY THIS IS HAPPENING 🧠

➤ Food is nutrient poor, even organic, because soils are depleted
➤ Toxins and pathogens constantly drain minerals
➤ Chronic stress, poor sleep, circadian disruption, screens, and overwork burn nutrients faster than they can be replaced

WHAT DEPLETION FEELS LIKE ⚡

➤ Chronic fatigue, even at rest
➤ Trouble sleeping or staying asleep
➤ Anxiety, brain fog, poor focus
➤ Nervous system dysregulation
➤ Low resilience to stress or illness

Not because your body is broken
But because it does not have the raw materials to run basic systems

FROM SYMPTOMS TO DISEASE

➤ Minor symptoms become louder
➤ Infections linger
➤ Inflammation persists
➤ Chronic conditions take hold

Many so called diseases sit on a foundation of long term depletion

WHAT DISEASE REALLY IS

Disease is not failure
It is the body struggling to heal with insufficient resources

When you were younger and well nourished, your body handled stress, toxins, and infections quietly
Now it’s louder, not because it’s weaker, but because it’s under supplied

HOW TO USE THIS LIST 📋

This list is not meant to overwhelm you
It’s meant to reveal a pattern

Different symptoms
Same root issue

START HERE FIRST

Before complex protocols
Before chasing supplements
Before advanced interventions

➤ Build a foundation
➤ Restore minerals and nutrients
➤ Support the body’s ability to function daily

Especially in a world that constantly demands more from it

NEXT STEP

If you want a refreshing, empowering perspective on health
Download my free FOUNDATIONS OF HEALING guide

👉 See links in bio or visit www.toxfreedoc.com to get started

🚨 How Bot Farms Are Misused to Make Millions (Explained for Awareness) 🚨
⚠️ Disclaimer: This content is shared strictly for educational and awareness purposes. No illegal activity is encouraged or promoted.
Have you ever wondered how some online fraud networks generate massive income using bot farms? 🤖💻
This reel breaks down the concept behind it in a simplified, non-technical way so creators, business owners, and students can understand the risks and protect themselves.
📌 At a high level, here’s what usually happens:
First, large-scale automated systems (often called bot farms) are created to simulate human-like online activity. These bots can visit websites, scroll pages, and interact with content—without being real people.
Next, some bad actors create low-quality or meaningless blog websites filled with auto-generated content. When bots repeatedly visit and interact with these sites, it can falsely signal “engagement” to ad platforms. As a result, ads may start appearing on those pages, creating revenue without genuine users 📈
💰 How money is made (conceptually):
Advertising platforms usually pay based on views or clicks. When fake traffic is involved, the system gets manipulated—leading to earnings that look legitimate on the surface but are actually driven by automation, not real audiences.
😟 The darker side:
In some cases, bot networks are also misused to overwhelm competitors’ websites with traffic. This can force businesses to spend more on servers, protection, or ads—slowly draining their money. This is why cybersecurity and traffic monitoring are so important today 🔐
🎯 Why you should care:
• If you run an online business 🧑‍💼
• If you monetize websites or apps 🌐
• If you’re learning digital marketing or tech 📚
💬 Comment “your favourite sports” if you want a full awareness guide on how these systems work and how businesses defend against them.
👣 Follow @podus.app for more content on tech, automation, cybersecurity.

Storytelling is what turns attention into connection 💗⁣

⁣

⁣
In 2026, storytelling is how you stand out in crowded feeds.⁣
⁣
It boosts retention, saves, and meaningful engagement ❤️⁣
⁣
Stories make your message memorable, relatable, and human.⁣
⁣
That’s how you build trust and authority, not just reach 🤍⁣
⁣
These 7 frameworks help you organize your ideas with intention.⁣
⁣

Master storytelling, your content depends on it 💛⁣

See people even behind walls with advanced Wi-Fi technology 🚀👀

In this video, we show a full 3D scan of an entire house of more than 600 square meters. Thanks to our Wi-Fi and Bluetooth system, we can detect all the devices inside the house using these technologies.
In addition, by using Wi-Fi CSI technology, we also collect information from the routers around the house. We take advantage of the fact that every time there is a change in any part of the environment, it means there is a human or some kind of movement.
All this data is analyzed through multiple artificial intelligence filters, giving us extremely accurate results. Every time someone passes in front of or near a signal area, the system provides the exact location of that person in real time.

A beautiful reminder of the family formed during one of cinema’s greatest journeys.

#lotr #lordoftherings #lotrfan #thehobbit #gandalf frodo ringsofpower lordoftheringsmemes legolas aragorn
